i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load brief, issue #373 spec, pre-rulings, glossary, and the #371 schema + fusion code. Record pass when loaded.
i0-context.finding: Loaded brief, #373 spec, pre-rulings, glossary, #371 schema doc, module_record.py, fusion.py, runtime_contracts.py, constructor_projection.py, fusion_training/{_train,_helpers,_metrics,_types,_calibration,_correction}.py, gold_defaults.toml, smoke_defaults.toml, test_module_record_emit.py. q1-baseline-meaning.title: What exactly must the harness BASELINE reproduce to 'match gold-cycle fusion numbers'?
q1-baseline-meaning.imperative: Resolve: the issue says reproduce fuse_module_fields_ordered AND confirm it matches gold-cycle fusion numbers. Code shows these are two different computations (per-entity Gaussian posterior vs scalar metric-blend in _measured_fusion_metrics). Pick the validation contract.
q1-baseline-meaning.finding: RULING: BASELINE validation = reproduce fuse_module_fields_ordered EXACTLY (call the real function; assert harness re-implementation matches it to <=1e-9 on a fixture, AND/OR have the harness call the real function directly so 'reproduce' is identity). The gold-cycle report number (2.94->1.76) comes from _measured_fusion_metrics = a SCALAR inverse-trace-weighted blend of per-module precomputed backtest metrics from details.json; it does NOT call fuse_module_fields_ordered. So 'match gold-cycle fusion numbers' cannot mean bit-match _measured_fusion_metrics. Validation gate = exact reproduction of the per-entity Gaussian posterior (the production runtime fusion). Cross-ref to the gold scalar fingerprint is reported as CONTEXT, not the gate.

q2-four-modules.title: What are the '4 module fields' per task and their order?
q2-four-modules.finding: Per module_names_for_task: order = (constructor_{tok}_from_recent_history, driver_{tok}_from_recent_history, constructor_{tok}_from_race_weekend, driver_{tok}_from_race_weekend), tok in {quali_power, race_start_power, race_power}. This 4-tuple order is the canonical index for the 4x4 R. runtime_module_order feeds fuse_module_fields_ordered in exactly this order.

q3-truth-signal.title: What is 'truth' for R estimation and for scoring?
q3-truth-signal.imperative: Resolve which record array is the latent truth (target_mu) and which is the outcome truth (outcome pairs / actual_positions).
q3-truth-signal.finding: Truth for R residuals = target_mu (retro-truth BT posterior mean per entity; optional array, present when has_target_mu). residual_im = module_pi - target_mu per entity i, module m. Standardize per (event,module) before pooling. Scoring truth: pairwise log-loss + spearman + rank-MAE use actual_positions (ground-truth finishing order) where present; outcome/pair_index give the pairwise labels already in the record. Coverage uses target_mu as the latent the credible interval should contain. Events lacking target_mu are excluded from R estimation; events lacking actual_positions excluded from ordering metrics. Represent missingness explicitly (skip + count), never impute.

q4-r-space.title: In what space is R estimated, and how is it applied per-event?
q4-r-space.imperative: Resolve the standardized-residual estimation space, pooling across disjoint entity sets, shrinkage toward I, and per-event GLS application scaled by each module's sigma_pi.
q4-r-space.finding: R estimated in per-(event,module)-standardized residual space: z_im = (pi_im - target_mu_i)/s_m where s_m = std of module m residuals within that event (or pooled module std). Pool z across events/entities -> 4x4 cross-module correlation R_hat = corr of stacked standardized residual columns aligned by module. Disjoint entity sets are fine because correlation is computed over the stacked (entity x event) standardized rows per module pair on their COMMON entities per event. Shrink: R_shrunk = (1-lambda)R_hat + lambda*I (Ledoit-Wolf-style; sweep lambda as ablation). Per-event application: build 4n x 4n joint obs covariance by scaling R's module blocks with each module's own sigma_pi (Kronecker-like: block(m,m')= corr_mm' * outer(sigma diag) using per-module sigma_pi), then GLS-combine the 4 aligned driver-space observations of latent pi under that joint covariance. R=I reproduces the independent product (sanity baseline).

q5-metrics.title: Exact metric definitions for the scorecard?
q5-metrics.imperative: Resolve pairwise log-loss, rank MAE, spearman, credible-interval coverage — computed on fused pi vs which truth, per task.
q5-metrics.finding: Scorecard per task, baseline vs A vs cheap-B (+ablations): (1) pairwise log-loss = mean over entity pairs of -log sigmoid-prob that fused pi orders the pair correctly, vs actual_positions ordering (matches the 'pairwise log-loss' fingerprint the epic cites). (2) rank MAE = mean abs diff between fused-pi rank and actual_positions rank. (3) spearman = rank corr fused-pi vs actual_positions. (4) calibration = credible-interval coverage: fraction of entities whose target_mu falls within the k-sigma interval from fused (pi, diag sigma_pi); report at nominal levels (e.g. 50/80/95%) and coverage error. All numpy. Per-event then averaged per task; also paired deltas A-baseline.

q6-generation.title: How are records generated within the 90-min budget?
q6-generation.imperative: Resolve: train vs reuse existing bundles; which span; backtest-only.
q6-generation.finding: RULING: NO TRAINING. All 12 gold module bundles already exist at outputs/evo_runs/gold_module_training_cycle/modules/. Generate records by BACKTEST-ONLY against existing bundles with --emit-module-record (schema doc 'Direct backtest invocation'); retro_truth + compound_prior present for all years. Span: eval_year 2025 first (gold eval); if a richer set is cheap, add. 12 backtests, no NN train -> well within 90 min. Verify one module's bundle path + single-backtest wall-time during execute before committing to all 12. Records are non-committed generated artifacts (gitignored).

q7-coverage.title: What event/task coverage is acceptable for a verdict?
q7-coverage.imperative: Resolve minimum tasks and events; what to state if partial.
q7-coverage.finding: Target: all THREE tasks (quali, race_start, race), each with its 4 modules, over the eval-year events that have target_mu AND actual_positions. Acceptance per brief: A and cheap-B reported vs baseline on all three tasks. If a task's records are infeasible/too sparse, report the tasks achieved and STATE coverage explicitly in the verdict (pre-ruling 4). Minimum credible verdict = >=1 task fully (baseline reproduced + A + cheap-B + ablations); stretch = all three. Event count per task stated in the scorecard.

q8-variant-placement.title: Where does variant A live relative to fuse_module_fields_ordered?
q8-variant-placement.imperative: Resolve source-compat constraint: A behind a flag/strategy, production default unchanged.
q8-variant-placement.finding: Pre-ruling 1: fuse_module_fields_ordered interface stays source-compatible; production DEFAULT behavior UNCHANGED. Variant A lives as an OPT-IN strategy behind the existing seam. Cleanest: a new pure function (e.g. fuse_module_fields_correlated or a strategy param on FusionLayerConfig defaulting to the current product) in src/evo_predictor/fusion.py, exercised ONLY by the harness in this issue. No call-site in production runtime flips to A. R estimation helper lives in fusion_training/ (offline). Reuse cheaply by harness.

q9-cheapB-isolation.title: How is cheap-B isolated from A?
q9-cheapB-isolation.imperative: Resolve: cheap-B = A restricted to the constructor/driver block of R; confirm it captures worst redundancy.
q9-cheapB-isolation.finding: cheap-B = variant A with R populated ONLY in the constructor<->driver cross-block (same evidence_source), R=I elsewhere (recent<->weekend off-blocks forced to 0 correlation / identity). It isolates the highest-prior redundancy (constructor projected field vs driver field, ~0.71-0.99). Implemented as a masking option on the same A code path (mask R to the 2 within-evidence constructor/driver pairs). Confirms whether the worst redundancy alone captures most of A's movement.

q10-verdict-gate.title: What decides the ordering-vs-calibration verdict?
q10-verdict-gate.imperative: Resolve the threshold/criterion separating 'A moves ordering' from 'A only tightens calibration'.
q10-verdict-gate.finding: Verdict criterion: A 'moves ordering' if it produces a material change in rank MAE and/or spearman and/or pairwise log-loss BEYOND noise vs baseline (paired across events; report effect size + the per-task deltas). A 'only tightens calibration' if coverage error shrinks materially while rank MAE/spearman/pairwise-LL are ~flat (within the per-event paired noise band). The epic fingerprint (LL 2.94->1.76 but rankMAE ~0.2) is the signature of a linear pool over correlated experts; if A's rankMAE/spearman move, redundancy was the bottleneck; if only coverage moves, headroom is in interactions (#374 territory, NOT this issue). Verdict is whatever the measurement says (pre-ruling 5); a null result is a complete deliverable.

q4a-per-entity-gls.title: q4a: per-entity GLS form (cross-module, not cross-entity)
q4a-per-entity-gls.finding: CLARIFICATION (refines q4): R is a 4x4 CROSS-MODULE correlation, NOT cross-entity. Apply PER ENTITY i: 4 modules give obs vector y_i=(pi_1i..pi_4i) of latent pi_i; obs cov Sigma_i = D_i R D_i, D_i=diag(sigma_1i..sigma_4i) from each module's per-entity sigma (sqrt of sigma_pi diagonal AFTER production covariance_scale+jitter, same scaling baseline uses). GLS: pi_i=(1^T Sigma_i^-1 1)^-1 (1^T Sigma_i^-1 y_i), var=(1^T Sigma_i^-1 1)^-1, folded with prior_sigma=10 prior as baseline does. R=I => diagonal Sigma_i => per-entity precision sum == baseline (on the diagonal). DECISION FOR PLAN: harness baseline calls the REAL fuse_module_fields_ordered (full nxn). Variant A's exact identity-to-baseline at R=I must be demonstrated; choose the A formulation that makes R=I reproduce baseline (either (a) per-entity diagonal GLS compared against a diagonalized baseline, or (b) 4nx4n block GLS with each module's full sigma_pi on block-diagonal and R coupling only same-entity cross-module terms, which reduces to baseline's full-matrix product at R=I). Implementer picks (b) if (a) cannot hit the <=1e-9 identity; document which.

consolidation.summary: Resolved problem statement persisted at .agent-work/issue-373-correlated-fusion/problem_statement.md. Headlines: harness validation gate = exact reproduction of fuse_module_fields_ordered (gold scalar metric-blend is context only); 4 modules per task = (constructor_recent, driver_recent, constructor_weekend, driver_weekend); R = 4x4 cross-module corr in standardized-residual (pi-target_mu) space, shrunk to I, applied per-entity via Sigma_i=D_i R D_i GLS, R=I reproduces baseline exactly; cheap-B = R masked to constructor/driver block; scorecard = pairwise-LL/rankMAE/spearman vs actual_positions + coverage vs target_mu; generation = backtest-only against 12 existing gold bundles with --emit-module-record (no training, <=90min); A is opt-in offline, production default UNCHANGED. No-live-human: resolutions from brief+pre-rulings+verified code, logged as understand-checkpoint decision evidence.
